messages:
Alex: Quick pass needed — we have a draft launch post for Redwood Optimize moving to embargoed preview next Wed at 10:00am PT. Need legal quickpass, final hero claim, demo seat map, and inbound lead routing CSV. Who can help with quick reviews?
Maria: I can do copy and CTA pass today. link: https://docs.redwood/optimize-launch-draft (comments enabled)
Jamal: I need to sanity-check the benchmark numbers — which eval set/source are we citing for the 2.3x throughput claim? Don’t want legal to flag an overclaim.
Sophia: Demo ops here — seat map: do we have regional slots for APAC? If webinar hits EU/APAC, we should split sessions. I can carve a 60-min and a 30-min variant.
Darren: For lead routing: HubSpot forms need utm params and property mapping. Quick snippet for UTM we should use: `?utm_source=blog&utm_medium=launch&utm_campaign=optimize_q2`
Leah: Suggest two CTAs: 1) "Try Optimize — free tier" and 2) "Request a demo — reserved seat". For the demo CTA, we need a hidden field to tag Dedicated vs Hosted interest.
Alex: Jamal — source is internal eval run 2025-11 (benchmark-run-113). Maria, can you add a parenthetical reference? Jamal, can you drop a short sentence we can cite?
Jamal: Yep — adding: "Internal eval (Nov 2025, benchmark-run-113) shows ~2.3x throughput vs baseline under 512-token avg load; see appendix link." Will paste exact phrasing in doc.
Maria: Updated hero paragraph and CTAs. Pasting new lead routing header:
```
lead_routing_map.csv
email,region,product_interest,source
{{email}},US,Optimize,blog
{{email}},EMEA,Optimize,blog
```
Sophia: Seat map idea — put 3 demo slots: 9am PT (Americas), 5pm CET (EMEA), 10pm JST (APAC). Each slot 45 min + 15min QA. We should cap at 50 attendees per slot.
Darren: Routing note — please include `product_interest` mapping to HubSpot field `hs_product_interest`. I can import CSV if columns match.
LegalBot: @here Legal quickpass queued. Please allow 24 hours for review for standard claims. If you mark as "priority-legal" I can escalate.
Leah: We need a short disclosure under benchmarks: "Results may vary by workload; see methodology in appendix." Maria can you tack that below the hero?
Maria: Added disclosure and the appendix link. Also added UTM to demo and try links.
Alex: Can Legal prioritize? This is embargoed to press — want signoff by tomorrow EOD.
LegalBot: Escalation requested by Alex accepted. Marked as priority-legal. Updating status in 4 hours.
Sophia: For registrations, I'll export attendee CSV after signups and share seat assignment rules. Will tag product interest and timezone.
Darren: I'll prepare HubSpot import template and drop in the doc in 30m.
Leah: Anyone object to preserving the two-CTA layout? It keeps trial funnel separate from sales demo.
Jamal: No objections. One ask: can we add a single-sentence caveat about quantized models in appendix? Might affect numbers.
Maria: Added a single line: "Benchmarks include mixed precision runs; quantization may affect throughput — see appendix."
Alex: Great — final checklist: legal signoff, Jamal quote inserted, Darren HubSpot template, Sophia seat map + capacity. If all green, we schedule embargo publish for Wed 10am PT. :thumbsup:
Maria: Will ping again once legal is green. :eyes:
